content.title: Official Virginia Lottery Mobile App | Download Now
content.text: It's Easy in the App! Play your favorite games, check winning numbers, and earn and redeem rewards from anywhere in Virginia. Plus, try our new fast-paced Tap games, available exclusively in the app. Download and go! Scan your ticket to see if it’s a winner View the latest winning numbers Find a Lottery retailer Want more? Login to the app! Explore additional games, earn and redeem rewards points, and claim prizes when you login to your Virginia Lottery account on the app. Play Instant Games Browse the Lottery's lineup on instant games and play them too! Try the new Tap Games in the app! Purchase Draw-Game Tickets Buy a ticket for Powerball, Mega Millions, Pick 3/4/5 with FIREBALL!, Cash 5 with EZ Match, & Cash4Life. Cash Winning Tickets Claim a prize of up to $5,000 in the Lottery app! Find out more about mobile cashing. Enter Promotions & Earn Rewards Points You can enter a Lottery promotion or submit tickets to earn Rewards points! View FAQ for more mobile app info. x Sign up for alerts Customize your alerts by adding the ones most relevant to your gameplay below.
